title: Gigabrain
tagline: Gigabrain is an AI Agent enhancing web3 data insights with top Subgraph data analytics
description: Gigabrain: The Subgraph Analyst is a Python-powered AI Agent deployed via Telegram bot. For web3 data analysts and researchers, as well as crypto users/traders/degens, Gigabrain unlocks advanced blockchain subgraph data analysis and monitoring, providing real-time insights and interactive data exploration with trending subgraph analytics.
how_its_made: This project is a Telegram bot designed for blockchain subgraph analysis, with an architecture that centers around real-time bot functionality. Gigabrain is deployed as a Python-powered bot on the Telegram core Bot API (BotFather). Gigabrain draws on data and usage metrics from the Graph protocol's Subgraph MCP.
